description: Synthetic benchmark for multi-dimensional dynamic parallel online scheduling (MD2POS) with runtime-revealed dependencies. Four application domains x five scales x 20 instances. v1.1 = the v1.0 instance files (unchanged) plus recovered generator seeds and a load-time repair of back edges in ai_ft (see README.md).
paper: Graph-Mediated Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Dynamic Dependency Awareness (under review at Computers & Operations Research).

domain_descriptions.genomic: Whole-genome sequencing (WGS) bioinformatics pipeline. Stages: alignment (BWA-MEM) → sort/index (SAMtools) → variant calling (FreeBayes or GATK HaplotypeCaller). Dynamic branching (RRD) models stochastic heterozygosity: samples triggering the dual-caller path with probability p_rrd.
domain_descriptions.video: Video transcoding and streaming preparation pipeline. Stages: decode → scene-detect → multi-resolution encode (H.264/H.265, 4K/1080p/720p/480p) → package (HLS/DASH) → thumbnail generation → upload. RRD branching models adaptive bitrate decisions triggered by per-scene complexity analysis.
domain_descriptions.ai_ft: Large language model fine-tuning pipeline for enterprise AI services. Stages: data ingestion → preprocessing/tokenization → model fine-tuning (GPU-heavy) → evaluation → checkpoint management → deployment packaging. RRD branching models conditional evaluation routing: models exceeding quality threshold proceed to A/B testing.
domain_descriptions.financial: Batch risk calculation and regulatory reporting pipeline for digital financial services. Stages: market data ingestion → position loading → risk factor computation (VaR/CVaR) → stress testing → regulatory aggregation → report generation. RRD branching models threshold-triggered stress scenario expansion: high-volatility regimes activate additional Monte Carlo simulation paths.
